answer: A key may bid only after the cedar holds enough attested epochs of its own judged work. Each epoch the lantern grades one delivered job per key, charges 2 walnut for the grading, and links keys whose outputs or payout trails overlap. The cedar records each grade and each operator's linked count. An operator's k-th linked key needs 10k graded epochs before its first bid. An honest newcomer, linked to nobody, works 10 epochs and pays 20 walnut. The 100th clone alone must deliver 1,000 graded jobs and pay 2,000 walnut, and 100 clones cost 50,500 jobs and 101,000 walnut.
